name: Electronics & PCB calculators
about: What KiCad's PCB Calculator has, plus the everyday ones: Ohm's law, voltage dividers, LED resistors, resistor colour codes, E-series values, RC / LC, 555 timers, regulators (LM317, 7805, AMS1117, buck), batteries, wire gauge, PCB track width (IPC-2221), vias, electrical spacing (IPC-2221B), track impedance (microstrip, stripline, coplanar, differential pairs), attenuators, fusing current, capacitors, op-amp gain, dB.
description: Exact electronics / PCB numbers: Ohm's law, voltage divider, LED resistor, resistor colour code, nearest E12/E24/E96 value, RC filter, LC resonance, 555 timer, regulator heat (LM317 / 7805 / AMS1117 / buck), battery run time, wire size, PCB track width for a current, via current, clearance for a voltage, track impedance (50 Ω, USB 90 Ω), attenuator pads, fusing current, capacitor energy, op-amp gain, dB / dBm. Use it whenever an answer needs a number — don't guess.
instructions:
Pick ONE calculator and fill its inputs from the request. Write every value WITH its unit as text ("12 V", "20 mA", "4.7k", "100 nF", "1.6 mm"). Leave out what the user didn't say. Calculators and their inputs:
- ohm: voltage, current, resistance, power (any two)
- divider: vin, vout, r1, r2, series (E24)
- led: supply, colour (red / green / blue / white…) or vf, current, count (in series)
- resistor_code: bands ("brown black orange gold") or value ("4.7k")
- e_series: value
- rc: resistance, capacitance, cutoff
- lc: inductance, capacitance, frequency
- timer555: mode (astable / monostable), r1, r2, capacitance, frequency or time
- regulator: regulator (LM317 / 7805 / AMS1117 / buck), vin, vout, current, r1, r2, package (TO-220 / SOT-223…)
- battery: capacity ("2200 mAh") or energy (Wh), voltage or chemistry + cells ("3S LiPo"), power or current (load), charge_current
- wire: current, length (one way), voltage, max_drop (%)
- trace_width: current, copper ("1 oz"), layer (outer / inner), temperature_rise, length
- via: drill, current, board_thickness, plating
- clearance: voltage (say AC or DC)
- impedance: target ("50 ohm", "90 ohm differential"), type (microstrip / stripline / coplanar), height (dielectric), er, width, gap
- attenuator: db, impedance
- fusing: width (track) or diameter (wire), time
- capacitor: capacitance, voltage, frequency, resistance
- opamp: gain, mode (inverting / non-inverting), rf, rg
- decibel: db, dbm, power, ratio
Example: {"calc": "trace_width", "inputs": {"current": "2 A", "copper": "1 oz", "layer": "outer"}}. Answer with the JSON only.
